subject: POC kickoff & timeline - Redwood trial for Aurora Systems
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Lowe <ethan.lowe@aurora-systems.com>, Samir Shah <samir.shah@aurora-systems.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff & timeline - Redwood trial for Aurora Systems

Hi Ethan / Samir —

Great to meet you both on the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary from discovery:
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for prod-grade chat & summarization workflows across Aurora's agent tooling. Primary success metric: 95% reduction in failed completions and <= 200ms median token latency for 8k context.
- Key stakeholders: Ethan (Product), Lara (Engineering), Samir (Security/Infra).
- Data: Aurora will provide a sanitized sample dataset (10k rows) and an onboarding account for trial.

Proposed evaluation plan / timeline (tentative):
1) Kickoff call + environment access — Week of Jun 22 (1 hour)
2) Setup & SOW signature — 2 business days after kickoff
3) Week 1: Baseline tests & model selection (Neha to run initial benchmarks)
4) Weeks 2-3: Integration, KV/prefix caching validation, and quality evaluation vs. your rubric
5) Final readout & recommendation — week of Jul 13

Ownership / asks from Aurora:
- Provide sanitized sample data and a short list of 10 representative prompts/test cases (by Jun 18)
- Confirm target success criteria and any absolute rejection thresholds
- Availability for a kickoff on Jun 22 (suggest 10am PT)

Attachments I will share after this message: SOW draft and a one‑page onboarding checklist so your infra team knows what access we need.

Next steps (action items):
- Ethan: confirm kickoff window and stakeholder list
- Marissa: share SOW draft + onboarding checklist
- Neha (cc) will propose an initial benchmark plan post-signature

Thanks — excited to get started.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0184

---
Attachment stubs: SOW_draft_v1.pdf (13 KB, draft), redwood-onboarding-checklist.xlsx (6 KB)

From: Ethan Lowe <ethan.lowe@aurora-systems.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Shah <samir.shah@aurora-systems.com>, Lara Chen <lara.chen@aurora-systems.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & timeline - Redwood trial for Aurora Systems

Thanks Marissa — this is great and matches our notes from the call. A few clarifications: 

- Success criteria: the 95% reduction target is spot on for failed completions; for latency let's aim for p50 <= 200ms and p95 <= 600ms given our current infra. We'll also include a subjective quality score (1-5) from our support agents; target >= 4 on avg.
- Data: I'll work with Lara to produce a sanitized dataset and the 10 prompts. Can get that to you by Thu, Jun 18.
- Stakeholders: Confirming attendees for kickoff: Ethan (me), Lara (eng lead), Samir (infra/security), Priya Natarajan (Analytics) — I will confirm Priya's availability tomorrow.

Jun 22 at 10am PT works for us. Please send calendar invite and any prep materials. Also, can you send the SOW and onboarding checklist (we'll need to route SOW to procurement for a quick review)?

One question on scope: will the trial environment be hosted by Redwood (hosted API) or do you support a private VPC deployment for this POC? We may need to evaluate both for security.

Appreciate it — see you next week.

—Ethan
Ethan Lowe
Sr. Product Manager, Aurora Systems
ethan.lowe@aurora-systems.com | +1 (206) 555-0110

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Lowe <ethan.lowe@aurora-systems.com>, Samir Shah <samir.shah@aurora-systems.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & timeline - Redwood trial for Aurora Systems

Thanks Ethan — great clarifications and all sounds doable. A few quick updates and confirmations: 

- Trial hosting: we can run an initial hosted trial (fastest) and simultaneously prepare a VPC option if you want to evaluate both. For procurement speed, hosted is usually faster for the first two weeks; we can document the VPC onboarding steps in the SOW.
- I've attached the SOW_draft_v1.pdf and the onboarding checklist (same as noted earlier). The SOW includes a one-week hosted trial scope plus an optional VPC addendum.
- Kickoff: tentatively scheduled for Tue, Jun 22 at 10:00 AM PT. I'll send a calendar invite after you confirm attendees.

Neha — can you own the initial benchmark plan and run a lightweight model selection pass the week of Jun 22 (baseline + 2 variants)? I expect initial results in 3 business days after access. Please confirm offline.

Action items (updated):
- Ethan: confirm final attendee list (including Priya) and approve the SOW routing path for procurement
- Samir: confirm required infra access details and any IP/routing constraints so we can include them in the onboarding checklist
- Neha: confirm benchmark plan and required accounts

Attachments: SOW_draft_v1.pdf, redwood-onboarding-checklist.xlsx

Thanks — I'll follow up with calendar invite and DocuSign link for SOW signature.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0184

From: Ethan Lowe <ethan.lowe@aurora-systems.com>

Cc: Samir Shah <samir.shah@aurora-systems.com>, Lara Chen <lara.chen@aurora-systems.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@aurora-systems.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & timeline - Redwood trial for Aurora Systems

Thanks Marissa — confirmed. Priya is in. Final attendee list: Ethan, Lara, Samir, Priya.

We reviewed the SOW draft and procurement wants the DocuSign link (please send). Infra items Samir flagged: outbound-only egress for the initial hosted trial, and we may need an IP allowlist for the private VPC option. Samir will follow up with a short list.

Jun 22 @ 10am PT confirmed — looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Ethan
